# Arcade Learning Environment browser runtime

`ale.js`, `ale.wasm`, `ale.data`, and `LICENSE` are unmodified files from the official npm package `@farama/ale-wasm@0.12.0`, downloaded with `npm pack @farama/ale-wasm@0.12.0`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Arcade-Learning-Environment

Version/tag: v0.12.0. Commit: `f96026b362956d89076ac57d73f2ce82a59881ca`.

Package tarball SHA1: `1fb5ae1ef8927fc15e36af17910958a1b908a977`.

The emulator is licensed under GPL-2.0. Copyright belongs to its upstream authors. `ale.data` is the upstream preloaded ROM data archive; this project makes no additional ownership claim over bundled game data.

Corresponding upstream source, including its build scripts, is distributed here as [ale-source-v0.12.0.zip](ale-source-v0.12.0.zip). It was downloaded from https://codeload.github.com/Farama-Foundation/Arcade-Learning-Environment/zip/refs/tags/v0.12.0. Runtime file hashes are recorded in `../verification/port.json`.
